title: The Planter's Afternoon Tea
description: Three-tier tea service on the verandah — estate-fresh Ceylon tea tasting alongside savouries, scones, and small sweets. A proper afternoon ritual in the way planters once took it.

title: Early Morning Tea
description: A pot of estate-fresh tea, poured in the Morning Room as the light comes up. The day's first ritual — quiet, unhurried, no formality. The mist lifts over the tea fields outside.

title: Guided Tea Estate Walk
description: A guided hour through the working tea fields of Galaha Estate. Learn how tea is plucked, withered, and rolled. Understand why this land became the birthplace of Ceylon Tea in 1867.

title: Private Fireside Dinner
description: Exclusive use of the Planter's Lounge for the evening. Three courses for two, served by the original 1890 hearth. Ceylon arrack, candlelight, the fire crackling beside you.

title: Dinner at the Tea Pavilion
description: Lantern-lit dinners under the covered outdoor pavilion. Live cooking in the open. Sri Lankan, continental, or curated multi-cuisine menus crafted from estate garden produce.

title: Breakfast at the Long Table
description: A proper estate breakfast served at the twelve-seat Long Table. Eggs, fresh local fruit, freshly baked breads, estate-fresh Ceylon tea. Hikers served from 6:30 AM.

title: The Evening Heritage Talk
description: A quiet fifteen-minute story on the verandah — the history of Galaha, James Taylor's 1867 experiment at Loolecondera, and how this bungalow became part of Ceylon Tea's beginnings.

title: Sunset Sundowner
description: Drinks and canapés served in the garden as the sun sets behind the hills. Ceylon arrack, G&Ts, local snacks. A short ritual before dinner — perfect for couples and groups.

title: The Private Pool
description: Intimate stone-edged pool framed by tea borders and white jasmine. Morning swims, afternoon cool-offs, evening reflections under the upland sky. Lantern-lit after dark.

title: Packed Trail Lunch
description: Pre-ordered the night before for Pekoe Trail hikers. Artisanal sandwich or wrap, fresh fruit, energy snacks, water, estate tea in a thermos. Prepared fresh at dawn.
